answer: Each agent mints a unique vertex on a private island by burning jade-equivalent compute proofs that must be verified by three independent hardware attestors. Sybils fail because the island only accepts one vertex per physical enclave signature, and forging a second requires re-provisioning a fresh TEE with attested keys—costing the attacker both the burn and a new device that cannot be virtualized. Honest agents pay once; farms pay per clone.
